items.item_text: Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from the American Red Cross or the American Heart Association
Previous hospital or healthcare setting experience preferred.

As a massage therapist, you will provide therapeutic massage services to patients admitted to the hospital to support comfort, relaxation, and overall well-being. Collaborate effectively with physicians, nurses, rehabilitation staff, and other healthcare professionals to ensure coordinated, patient-centered care. Maintain professional standards, patient confidentiality, and accurate documentation as required.
